profile_pipeline: profile a pipeline by running each stage separately across different concurrency levels and measuring QPS
create_ProfileHook: create a custom ProfileHook subclass to execute code before and after each pipeline stage profiling
build_ProfileResult: build a ProfileResult dataclass to store profiling stats including concurrency, QPS, and occupancy rate
check_diagnostic_mode: check if the SPDL_PIPELINE_DIAGNOSTIC_MODE environment variable is enabled for self-diagnostic pipeline profiling
set_default_profile_callback: set a default callback function that receives ProfileResult after each pipeline stage is benchmarked
